EmailTemplate.name: Internal User Account Activation
EmailTemplate.subject: Your Wadhwani Grants Platform account — activate your access
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Subject: Your Wadhwani Grants Platform account — activate your access
Hello {{{user_first_name}}},
You've been set up on the Wadhwani Grants Platform as {{{role_name}}}.
To get started, activate your account and choose your password here:
{{{activation_link}}}
This activation link expires in {{{link_expiry_hours}}} hours.
Once you log in, any assignments already made for you will appear on your dashboard. Future assignments will also be shared by email.
If you weren’t expecting this invitation, simply reply to this email.
Wadhwani Grants Platform
Questions? Contact us: [grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org](mailto:grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org)
© {{{year}}} Wadhwani Charitable Foundation
